notes.title: Boars in Rome Playtest is Live!
notes.content:
Hello!

We have released a Playtest version of Boars in Rome right here on steam! This is a version that we showcased live at Dutch AnimeCon.

You sign up for the playtest by going to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3676250/Boars_in_Rome/]store page[/url] and clicking "Play Now".

Everything you see is still work in progress but we hope you have fun with it! There are 2 levels:
[list]
[*] Catacombs (Tutorial + Underground Area)
[*] Flooded City (More polished city envrironment)
[/list]

Please let us know how things go. We'd love to hear your thoughts and see your stylish clips on [url=https://discord.gg/Hq8j2J3kCa]discord[/url], as a reply to this post, or in the community hub :)

Note: the Flooded City level is better optimised than the Catacombs. If you run into performance issues, please let us know!
